incident.title: A worker dies during the voice rush
incident.brief: At 00:12 a primary inference rank stops serving during an interactive voice rush. Voice may spill into the alternate pool. Keep at least 97% of voice turns on deadline and complete at least 25% of batch work. The alternate model is approved for voice only. Use reservation, overflow and batch admission as needed. Restore regular admission after recovery.

model.reason: The plan preserves batch work where targets allow it, meeting the owner's preference.
